title: Divine Mercy Novena
description: A nine-day novena given by Jesus Himself to St. Faustina, prayed especially during the octave of Easter. This powerful devotion focuses on God's infinite mercy and our call to trust completely in His compassion.
intention: For God's mercy upon ourselves and the whole world, conversion of sinners, and trust in divine compassion
instructions: This novena was dictated by Jesus to St. Faustina and is traditionally prayed from Good Friday to Divine Mercy Sunday (the Sunday after Easter). However, it can be prayed at any time. Each day focuses on a different group of souls that Jesus wants us to bring to His merciful Heart. Include your personal intentions while offering prayers for these specific groups.
background_info: The Divine Mercy devotion was revealed to St. Faustina Kowalska in the 1930s. Jesus asked her to spread devotion to His Divine Mercy, promising great graces to those who trust in His mercy and show mercy to others. The famous image shows Jesus with red and pale rays emanating from His Heart, representing the Blood and Water that flowed from His pierced side. The chaplet and novena are powerful prayers for obtaining God's mercy.

days.title: Day 1: All Mankind, Especially Sinners
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: Merciful Father, look with kindness upon the human family gathered at the foot of the Cross. Every one of us has sinned; every one of us stands in need of the grace that flows from your Son's wounds. Receive our prayer for the whole world: for those who have wandered far from you, for those who feel beyond forgiveness, and for each of us who asks for mercy we do not deserve. Let your goodness outrun our guilt, that all hearts may turn to you and live. Amen.
days.reflection: Jesus begins this novena by asking us to pray for all humanity, especially sinners. His mercy is not limited to the 'worthy' but is poured out especially on those who most need it. We are all sinners in need of mercy, and we pray that all people may experience God's compassionate love.
days.intention_prayer: Jesus, I trust in Your mercy. Today I pray especially for all sinners and for my own need of Your forgiveness: [pause for personal intentions].
days.scripture: "But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us." - Romans 5:8 (WEB)

days.title: Day 2: The Souls of Priests and Religious
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: Heavenly Father, remember in your mercy those who serve your Church as priests, deacons, and religious. They carry your word to many hearts, and they bear that burden in their own flesh. Renew them where they are weary, heal them where they are wounded, and let the tenderness of your mercy keep alive the grace of their vocation. Grant that through their hands many souls may find their way home to you. Amen.
days.reflection: Priests and religious have dedicated their lives to serving God and His people. They need our prayers and God's special graces to fulfill their calling faithfully. Their ministry is essential for the salvation of souls and the growth of the Church.
days.intention_prayer: Jesus, I pray for all priests and religious. Strengthen them in their vocation and help them to be faithful instruments of Your mercy.
days.scripture: "How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace, who brings good news of good things, who publishes salvation." - Isaiah 52:7 (WEB)

days.title: Day 3: All Devout and Faithful Souls
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: Lord Jesus, you have drawn many hearts close to your Sacred Heart. Bless the faithful and devout souls who love you in prayer, in the sacraments, and in the quiet duties of each day. Keep them from complacency, and let their faithfulness become an offering for those who have none to pray for them. Unite their hidden sacrifices to your own, that mercy may reach souls through a love like yours. Amen.
days.reflection: Faithful souls who strive to live according to God's will bring consolation to the Heart of Jesus. Even these devoted souls need God's mercy and grace to persevere in their faith journey and to continue growing in holiness.
days.intention_prayer: Jesus, I pray for all faithful souls who strive to follow You. Grant them perseverance and continued growth in Your love.
days.scripture: "Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things." - Matthew 25:21 (WEB)

days.title: Day 4: Those Who Do Not Know Jesus
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: Father of mercies, we pray for those who do not believe in you, and for those who have never heard your name spoken with love. Let the light of your truth reach them - not as an argument, but as an encounter. Soften what is hardened, awaken what is asleep, and prepare in their hearts a place where your mercy may rest. Give your Church patience and gentleness for this work, that no soul may be left outside the fold you desire to gather. Amen.
days.reflection: Jesus' mercy extends to all people, including those who have never heard the Gospel or who have not yet recognized Him as their Savior. We pray that God's light may shine upon them and that they may come to know His love.
days.intention_prayer: Jesus, I pray for all who do not yet know You. Send Your light into their hearts and help them to discover Your love.
days.scripture: "The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness. But he is patient with us, not wishing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance." - 2 Peter 3:9 (WEB)

days.title: Day 5: The Souls of Separated Brethren
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: Lord Jesus, you desired the unity of all who follow you. Bring back to the one fold our brothers and sisters who are separated from the Church. Heal the wounds of division, old and new; where mistrust and misunderstanding have hardened hearts, let your mercy make them supple. Teach us, who remain within the visible fold, to seek them without pride and to love them without rivalry, until there is one flock and one shepherd. Amen.
days.reflection: Jesus desires the unity of all Christians. We pray for our separated brothers and sisters in other Christian denominations, that the Holy Spirit may guide all Christians toward the unity that Christ desires for His Church.
days.intention_prayer: Jesus, I pray for Christian unity. May all who call upon Your name be drawn together in truth and love.
days.scripture: "I have other sheep, which are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will listen to my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd." - John 10:16 (WEB)

days.title: Day 6: The Meek and Humble Souls and Little Children
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Sun, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: Father, you hide your mysteries from the wise and reveal them to the lowly. Look upon the meek and humble souls and upon all little children, and let their innocence win for the world the showers of grace it has refused. Give us their simplicity: to trust you as a child trusts, to ask as a child asks, to hope as a child hopes. May mercy find in our smallness the room it seeks. Amen.
days.reflection: Jesus has a special love for those who are meek and humble, and for children who trust simply and completely. These souls teach us how to approach God with the right attitude of heart - with humility, trust, and childlike faith.
days.intention_prayer: Jesus, help me to become meek and humble like You. I pray for all children and those who have childlike trust in You.
days.scripture: "Unless you turn and become like little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven." - Matthew 18:3 (WEB)

days.title: Day 7: The Souls Who Especially Venerate and Glorify Jesus' Mercy
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: Lord Jesus, you have promised that souls who honor your mercy will find in your Heart everything they need. Strengthen all who venerate you as the Mercy of God: in their intercession, in their endurance, and in their joy. And when we come to you emptied of every merit, let the depth of your mercy supply what our poverty lacks. Amen.
days.reflection: Those who have a special devotion to Divine Mercy become powerful intercessors and instruments of God's compassion. Their trust in God's mercy gives them strength to serve others and to persevere through difficulties.
days.intention_prayer: Jesus, I want to be among those who glorify Your mercy. Help me to trust in You completely and to show mercy to others.
days.scripture: "Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy." - Matthew 5:7 (WEB)

days.title: Day 8: The Souls Who Are Detained in Purgatory
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: Merciful Father, remember the souls in purgatory, still held in your purifying love. Let your mercy come to their relief in their trials, and open heaven to them at the time you have appointed. We offer our prayers and sacrifices today for them, especially for those who are most forgotten, that they may soon be united with you and with the souls they have loved. Amen.
days.reflection: The souls in purgatory are being purified to enter heaven, but they cannot pray for themselves. Our prayers and sacrifices can help speed their journey to eternal happiness. They will remember our kindness and pray for us when they reach heaven.
days.intention_prayer: Jesus, I pray for all the souls in purgatory, especially [mention deceased loved ones]. May Your mercy shorten their purification and bring them quickly to heaven.
days.scripture: "It is therefore a holy and wholesome thought to pray for the dead, that they may be delivered from their sins." - 2 Maccabees 12:46 (DRC)

days.title: Day 9: The Souls Who Have Become Lukewarm
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: Lord Jesus, you do not reject a soul that trusts you, however tepid it has grown. We bring you the lukewarm: those who believe but do not act, who love a little but not with their whole heart. Kindle in them your fire, and in us whatever indifference we cling to. Draw them - and us - into the warmth of your Heart, that no soul in this novena may leave it unchanged. Amen.
days.reflection: Lukewarm souls are those who have grown indifferent in their faith - neither hot nor cold, but spiritually tepid. Jesus finds this particularly painful because these souls know Him but have allowed their love to grow cold. We pray for renewal and rekindling of their first love.
days.intention_prayer: Jesus, I pray for all lukewarm souls, including myself when I grow spiritually cold. Rekindle the fire of Your love in all our hearts.
days.scripture: "So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will spit you out of my mouth." - Revelation 3:16 (WEB)

source: Given by Jesus to St. Faustina Kowalska
notes: This novena is traditionally prayed from Good Friday to Divine Mercy Sunday, but can be prayed at any time. Each day focuses on bringing a different group of souls to God's mercy. The Divine Mercy Chaplet can be prayed along with this novena. Jesus promised great graces to those who pray this novena and trust in His mercy.
